intro: 12 個投資情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: Some people are risk takers and prefer to invest aggressively.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡冒險,偏好積極進取地投資。

ex.en: His ideas were not well received because he spoke so aggressively.
ex.zh: 他的想法不受歡迎,因為他說話太咄咄逼人。

note: aggressive 積極的、具侵略性的;aggression 侵略

ex.en: The new fund manager's attitude changed quickly after the first big downturn in the market.
ex.zh: 市場第一次大幅下跌後,新任基金經理人的態度很快就變了。

ex.en: Each investor should assess his or her own attitude toward investment.
ex.zh: 每位投資人都應評估自己對投資的態度。

note: attitude toward / to sth 對⋯的態度

ex.en: It is a good idea to commit a certain percentage of your income to investments.
ex.zh: 把收入的一定比例投入投資,是個好主意。

ex.en: The stockbroker committed herself to finding the best investments for each client.
ex.zh: 這位股票經紀人致力於為每位客戶找到最好的投資標的。

note: commit A to B 把 A 投入 B;commit oneself to V-ing 致力於(to 是介係詞)

ex.en: Her conservative strategy paid off over the years.
ex.zh: 她保守的策略多年下來獲得了回報。

ex.en: Generally, older people should be more conservative in their investing than younger people.
ex.zh: 一般來說,年長者的投資應該比年輕人更保守。

ex.en: If you have extra funds, talk to your stockbroker about the best place to put them.
ex.zh: 如果你有多餘的資金,可以和你的股票經紀人談談該投在哪裡最好。

ex.en: My stockbroker recommended investing in this fund.
ex.zh: 我的股票經紀人推薦投資這檔基金。

note: mutual fund 共同基金;raise funds 募款

ex.en: The chief financial officer invested in the stock at a very good time.
ex.zh: 財務長在非常好的時機買進了這檔股票。

ex.en: Don't invest all of your time in just one project.
ex.zh: 別把你所有的時間都投入在單一專案上。

note: invest (money / time) in sth 把(錢、時間)投入某事

ex.en: The CEO's long-term goal was to increase the return on investment.
ex.zh: 執行長的長期目標是提高投資報酬率。

ex.en: Long-term investments are not really affected by the daily ups and downs of the stock market.
ex.zh: 長期投資其實不太受股市每日漲跌的影響。

note: in the long term 從長遠來看

ex.en: Investors are advised to have diverse portfolios.
ex.zh: 投資人被建議要有多元化的投資組合。

ex.en: The investor's portfolio consisted of blue chip company stocks and government bonds.
ex.zh: 這位投資人的投資組合包含績優股和政府公債。

note: 另指「作品集」;diverse 多樣的
blue chip 績優股;government bond 政府公債

ex.en: A lot of people pulled out their money when it became clear that the bank was in trouble.
ex.zh: 當銀行明顯陷入困境時,很多人把錢撤了出來。

ex.en: He pulled out of the company and took all of his money with him.
ex.zh: 他退出了公司,並帶走了他所有的錢。

note: pull out of sth 退出某事

ex.en: If you don't invest in petroleum resources now, you will see the stock prices get away from you.
ex.zh: 如果你現在不投資石油資源,就會眼看著股價漲到你追不上。

ex.en: The company's most valuable resource was its staff.
ex.zh: 這家公司最寶貴的資源是它的員工。

note: human resources 人力資源;natural resources 天然資源

ex.en: The 44 percent return on the new stock was far more than the stockbroker had anticipated.
ex.zh: 新股票百分之四十四的報酬,遠遠超出股票經紀人的預期。

ex.en: Some investors are satisfied with a 5% return, while others want a much larger return.
ex.zh: 有些投資人滿足於百分之五的報酬,有些人則想要高得多的報酬。

note: return on investment (ROI) 投資報酬率

ex.en: If you invest wisely, you will be able to retire early.
ex.zh: 如果你投資得明智,就能提早退休。

ex.en: Mary wisely followed her stockbroker's advice and took her money out of some bad investments.
ex.zh: 瑪莉明智地聽從了股票經紀人的建議,把錢從一些不好的投資中撤出。
